landing.tojung.h1: 2026 Tojeong Bigyeol — Preview the Luck of Your Year Ahead
landing.tojung.intro: Tojeong Bigyeol is a traditional Korean yearly fortune that dates back to the Joseon-era scholar Tojeong Yi Ji-ham. Taoist analyzes your birth date and birth time with Saju (Korean four-pillars astrology) to map out your 2026 flow — the Year of the Red Horse (Byeong-o) — completely free.
landing.tojung.whatBody:
Tojeong Bigyeol is a traditional reading that combines the year's heavenly stem and earthly branch with your personal Saju to reveal the broad arc of your year and the fortune of each month.
Koreans have long consulted it at the start of the new year to prepare ahead, with guidance covering wealth, health, relationships, and disputes across everyday life.
landing.tojung.howTitle: How to Read Your Tojeong Bigyeol
landing.tojung.howBody:
Just enter your birth date (solar or lunar) and birth time. If you don't know your birth time, you can leave it as unknown and still get a reading.
Taoist builds an accurate Saju chart using the Manseryeok almanac, then compares it against the energy of 2026 (the Year of the Red Horse) to unfold your overall and month-by-month fortune.
landing.tojung.sampleBody:
Overall: A busy year, but one that bears fruit. The effort you sow in the first half ripens into wealth in the second.
March: New connections and opportunities arrive — don't hesitate. July: A time to watch both your health and your spending.
landing.tojung.faqA1: Yes. Taoist's core 2026 Tojeong Bigyeol reading is free to view, with no sign-up required.
landing.tojung.faqQ2: Can I get a reading without knowing my birth time?
landing.tojung.faqA2: Absolutely. If you don't know your birth time, leave it as 'unknown' and we'll read your yearly flow from your birth date. Knowing your birth time simply makes the analysis more precise.
landing.tojung.faqQ3: Should I enter a solar or lunar birth date?
landing.tojung.faqA3: Either works. When you enter your date, just select solar or lunar and the Manseryeok almanac converts it accurately for the calculation.
landing.tojung.faqQ4: How is the New Year fortune different from Tojeong Bigyeol?
landing.tojung.faqA4: Tojeong Bigyeol is closer to the traditional month-by-month reading, while the New Year fortune uses your full Saju for an in-depth AI analysis by theme (wealth, love, career, and more).

landing.newyear.sampleBody:
Wealth: A year when doors open to extra income beyond your steady earnings. Opportunities cluster in spring and late autumn.
Love: A time to deepen existing bonds rather than chase new ones. Career: Your reputation grows by building substance rather than switching jobs or expanding.
landing.newyear.faqQ1: Is the New Year fortune paid?
landing.newyear.faqA1: The New Year fortune is a premium reading where our AI analyzes your full Saju in depth. You can try our free readings first to get a feel before upgrading.
landing.newyear.faqA2: 2026 is Byeong-o (丙午), the Year of the Red Horse. With strong fire (火) energy, it's read as a year that highlights activity and drive.
landing.newyear.faqQ3: Can I read it alongside Tojeong Bigyeol?
landing.newyear.faqA3: Yes. Use Tojeong Bigyeol for your month-by-month reading and the New Year fortune for in-depth flow by area — together they help you prepare for the year from every angle.
landing.newyear.faqQ4: Is it less accurate if I don't know my birth time?
landing.newyear.faqA4: Knowing your birth time adds the hour pillar for greater precision. If you don't know it, leave it as 'unknown' and we'll still deliver a meaningful reading based on your year, month, and day.

landing.lifetime.h1: Lifetime Fortune — The Life Map Drawn by Your Saju
landing.lifetime.intro: Lifetime fortune reads the temperament you were born with and the broad arc of your whole life, based on the Saju chart of the moment you were born. It even traces your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles), drawing a map of your life.
landing.lifetime.whatBody:
Lifetime fortune reads your innate personality, talents, capacity for wealth, and the texture of your relationships through the balance of the Five Elements held in your four pillars — the year, month, day, and hour of your Saju.
It goes further to examine the flow of your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles), gauging when you're on the rise and when it's time to consolidate.
landing.lifetime.howTitle: How to Read Your Lifetime Fortune
landing.lifetime.howBody:
Enter your birth date and birth time, and the Manseryeok almanac calculates your precise Saju chart and Dae-un (10-year luck cycles).

landing.lifetime.sampleBody:
Temperament: A Saju anchored by fire (火) energy, giving you strong drive and expressiveness.
Dae-un: From your mid-thirties, you enter a roughly 20-year rising cycle where wealth and reputation climb together. For health, reinforcing water (水) energy in midlife and beyond is key.
landing.lifetime.faqQ1: Is lifetime fortune different from the New Year fortune?
landing.lifetime.faqA1: Lifetime fortune covers the broad arc of your entire life and your innate temperament, while the New Year fortune reads a single specific year. Use lifetime fortune for the big map, and the New Year fortune for that year's path.
landing.lifetime.faqQ2: Does it tell me my Dae-un?
landing.lifetime.faqA2: Yes. Using the Manseryeok almanac, we calculate your Dae-un (10-year luck cycles) and guide you through life's rising and consolidating phases stage by stage.
landing.lifetime.faqQ3: Can I read it without knowing my birth time?
landing.lifetime.faqA3: The broad flow can be read from your year, month, and day alone. That said, the hour pillar influences your later years, children, and career, so knowing it improves precision.
landing.lifetime.faqQ4: Do I only need to read my lifetime fortune once?
landing.lifetime.faqA4: Your birth chart never changes, so a single reading serves as a lifelong map. For the luck that shifts year to year, we recommend complementing it with the New Year fortune.
